name: jarvis-learn
description: Sends redacted, owner-approved learning episodes from your VS Code sessions to your local JARVIS.

jarvisLearn.jarvisUrl.description: JARVIS base URL. Must be http on loopback (127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1]); anything else is refused.

jarvisLearn.capture.transcripts.description: Read AI assistant session transcripts already stored locally (Claude Code).

jarvisLearn.capture.git.description: Capture commits (message, changed files, diff stats and a size-limited diff).

jarvisLearn.capture.terminal.description: Capture terminal commands run with shell integration (command, cwd, exit code, output tail).

jarvisLearn.capture.diagnostics.description: Capture error-to-fix pairs from editor diagnostics.

jarvisLearn.capture.saves.description: Capture file saves (path and diff statistics only).

jarvisLearn.transcripts.projects.description: Claude Code project folders to capture (folder names under ~/.claude/projects, or workspace paths). Empty means the current workspace folders only.

jarvisLearn.transcripts.backfill.description: Also read transcripts that existed before the extension was first run.

jarvisLearn.excludePaths.description: Extra path segments or globs to drop entirely. Secret files (.env*, *.pem, *.key, id_*, Token.txt, credentials*) are always excluded and cannot be re-enabled.

jarvisLearn.queue.maxMegabytes.description: Cap for the offline queue; the oldest episodes are dropped first.

jarvisLearn.git.maxDiffBytes.description: Maximum diff size captured per commit.
